info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Market Operation Order Allocations-spec
info.description: The Market Operation Order Allocation Retrieval API provides businesses with access to a comprehensive list of order allocations associated with market operations. This API enables users to efficiently gather data on various order allocations, which is essential for analyzing and managing operational workflows. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and operations managers seeking insights into market order performance and allocation strategies. By utilizing this endpoint, users can streamline their decision-making processes based on real-time order allocation information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a complete list of order allocations in the market operations. It provides a comprehensive overview of current allocations, which can be used for analysis and reporting purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve order allocation information within the market operations. It requires a specific JSON payload that outlines the parameters for the request.

ListMarketOperationOrderAllocationsReque.description: Represents the body of a request for order allocation in market operations.

ListMarketOperationOrderAllocationsRespo.description: This schema represents the response structure for the order allocation operation, containing the list of order items, pagination information, sorting options, and metadata about the response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Authentication mechanism. Clients must include a bearer token in the 'Authorization' header to authenticate requests.
